name: Workspace Stash
author: Elnathan Hod
description: Workspace-level minimize/restore: stash every window on the current workspace and restore the accumulated set with a gesture or SUPER+M.

barWidget.description: Shows the current stash and its contents

schema.label: Display style
schema.description: count is the most stable option across icon themes, long names, and narrow bars.

schema.label: Overflow style
schema.description: Prefix shown before the overflow count when names/icons are truncated: +N or ..N. Independent of overflowCountMode below.

schema.label: Overflow count
schema.description: What the overflow count means, independent of overflowStyle above. leftover shows how many are hidden; total shows the full stashed count.
